tools.name: mysaas_search_memes
tools.description: Find and show the final visual shortlist for an existing SaaS/startup meme or reaction image. Describe the complete situation naturally in French or English; this tool should be called once and returns up to five equal-weight choices with titles, joke explanations, badges, previews, and canonical li

tools.name: mysaas_get_meme
tools.description: Use this when the user or another tool has already selected a mysaas.lol slug and you need the complete public meme context, OCR, accessibility text, credit, reuse guidance, and canonical URLs. Do not use it to search or to retrieve hidden/raw assets.

tools.name: mysaas_get_share_format
tools.description: Use this after a mysaas.lol meme has been selected and you need one copy-ready first-party format for Reddit, Markdown, a forum, a CMS, a plain link, a direct image, or oEmbed. Returns the format together with the required credit, license URL, and canonical destination. Do not use before choosing a

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "mysaas_search_memes" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: audience, context, exclude_slugs, limit, platform, tone

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.mysaas.lol" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mysaas_get_meme, mysaas_get_share_format · Public sink: mysaas_get_share_format · Destructive: mysaas_get_share_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mysaas_get_meme, mysaas_get_share_format · Public sink: mysaas_get_share_format · Destructive: mysaas_get_share_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
